questions.question: Q1. What does the term "Enterprise" refer to in the context of enterprise management?
options: A for-profit business company that produces services or products
A government agency responsible for regulatory oversight
A non-profit organization focused on social welfare
An educational institution offering degree programs
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q2. Which of the following best defines "Management"?
options: The coordination and organization of resources, people, and processes to achieve specific goals
The creation of financial reports for stakeholders
The use of technology to automate business operations
The process of producing goods and services for customers
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q3. Enterprise Management is best described as:
options: The systematic approach used to oversee all activities within a business to achieve objectives
A method of managing only the financial aspects of a business
A strategy focused exclusively on marketing and customer acquisition
A government framework for regulating businesses
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q4. Which of the following are listed as specific resources of an enterprise?
options: Marketing, sales, advertising, branding, and pricing
People, capital, materials, space, and time
Inputs, outputs, feedback, process, and control
Planning, organizing, leading, controlling, and staffing
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q5. In enterprise management, the products generated by a business are referred to as:
options: Assets
Outputs
Inputs
Resources
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q6. Which of the following is an example of an enterprise mentioned in the text?
options: Harvard University
The World Health Organization
The United Nations
Walmart
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q7. Which of the following best explains why creativity and innovation are increasingly demanded in today's business environment?
options: The business environment is increasingly competitive
Governments require businesses to innovate for tax benefits
Technological advancements have made innovation unnecessary EM MCQ BANK
Customers prefer traditional products and services
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q8. Raw materials, labour, equipment, and technology are examples of:
options: Resources plans
Inputs
Products
Outputs
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q9. Enterprise management involves which of the following key activities?
options: Making strategic decisions, coordinating resources, managing personnel, and implementing processes
Only managing personnel and finances
Implementing technology and marketing campaigns only
Making strategic decisions and coordinating resources only
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q10. Which statement is TRUE about an enterprise?
options: An enterprise can only be a small business
An enterprise is created and operated by a government body
An enterprise only focuses on producing physical goods
An enterprise can range from a small business to a multinational corporation
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q11. How many core areas of enterprise management are identified in Chapter 1?
options: Seven
Six
Five
Eight
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q12. Which core area of enterprise management is described as "the backbone of every enterprise management plan"?
options: Financial management
Operations management
Strategic management
Human resource management
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q13. Which of the following is a key responsibility of Financial Management?
options: Designing and launching new marketing campaigns
Developing customer service policies
Managing cash flow, debt, liabilities, and equity
Recruiting and training employees
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q14. According to the text, operations management is responsible for:
options: Recruiting and compensating employees
Managing customer complaints and feedback
Converting inputs into outputs as effectively as possible
Creating marketing campaigns and brand strategies
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q15. Philip Kotler and Kevin Lane Keller define marketing management as the development, design, and implementation of marketing programs that recognize:
options: The breadth and interdependencies of the business environment
The role of technology in business automation
The importance of financial planning
The need for employee training and development
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q16. Which of the following activities falls under Marketing Management? EM MCQ BANK Chapter 1: Enterprise Management (Nature, Core Areas & 21st Century Challenge… Page 6 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
options: Conducting financial audits and preparing reports
Managing employee performance reviews
Identifying target audience groups and decision-makers
Implementing cybersecurity measures
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q17. Customer Relationship Management (CRM) primarily aims to:
options: Enhance the customer's overall experience
Develop new technology infrastructure
Maximize profits through aggressive sales tactics
Manage internal employee communications
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q18. Which of the following is an activity performed under CRM?
options: Recruiting and onboarding new employees
Setting financial budgets for the company
Conducting SWOT analysis
Managing customer complaint tickets in a timely manner
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q19. According to Edwin Flippo, Human Resource Management includes:
options: Product development and innovation management
Strategic resource allocation and IT planning
Planning, organizing, directing, and controlling of human resources
Financial planning and investment management
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q20. Which of the following is a function of Information Technology Management?
options: Overseeing business data management including storage, maintenance, and protection
Conducting market research and competitive analysis
Managing supplier relationships and procurement
Developing new product lines for customers
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q21. Process design in operations management refers to:
options: Developing financial forecasting models
Creating, implementing, and administering effective operations systems and practices
Designing employee performance appraisal processes
Creating branding strategies for new products
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q22. Which of the following best describes the role of IT Management regarding cybersecurity?
options: Managing customer data to improve sales conversions
Implementing cybersecurity and risk management to keep systems safe
Recruiting IT specialists for the marketing department
Developing advertising strategies to protect brand reputation
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q23. HRM activities include which of the following?
options: Developing performance management plans and succession planning
Conducting SWOT analysis for strategic planning
Overseeing network infrastructure and software systems
Analyzing competitors' pricing strategies
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q24. Financial management requires which of the following tools?
options: A reliable accounting team and financial tools
An effective marketing team and advertising budget
An operations team and production equipment
An HR team and recruitment platforms EM MCQ BANK
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q25. Which component is crucial for a successful strategic management plan?
options: Conducting SWOT analysis to identify threats and growth opportunities
Maximizing advertising spend on new products
Outsourcing all non-core business functions
Reducing the workforce to cut costs
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q26. Which of the following is identified as a key challenge for businesses in the 21st century?
options: Decreased reliance on digital systems
Reduction in global competition
Simplification of regulatory requirements
Rapid technological advancements disrupting industries
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q27. What does "Digital Transformation" require managers to do?
options: Reduce investment in online platforms
Focus solely on traditional business models
Lead organizations through initiatives to optimize processes and enhance customer experiences
Replace all human employees with automated systems
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q28. The modern workforce described in the chapter includes:
options: Multiple generations, remote workers, and gig economy participants
Only full-time employees working in a single office
Only highly skilled technical professionals
Employees from a single cultural background
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q29. Talent Management challenges primarily involve:
options: Finding and retaining top talent while addressing the skills gap
Finding the right advertising agency for marketing campaigns
Developing new IT infrastructure
Managing supplier contracts and procurement negotiations
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q30. Which 21st-century challenge requires managers to ensure ethical decision-making and drive corporate social responsibility initiatives?
options: Data privacy and security
Ethical and social responsibility
Change management
Agility and adaptability
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q31. Which of the following best defines "Agility and Adaptability" as a business challenge?
options: The ability to maintain the same business strategy for decades
Avoiding change in organizational structure
Fostering organizational agility to respond effectively to market shifts and disruptions
Reducing investments in technology to control costs
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q32. Data Privacy and Security challenges require managers to:
options: Reduce reliance on digital systems entirely EM MCQ BANK
Implement robust cybersecurity measures and comply with data protection regulations
Share all customer data with third parties for better service
Prioritize marketing data collection over legal compliance
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q33. Which challenge deals with implementing new strategies, technologies, or organizational structures?
options: Work-life balance
Globalization
Change management
Talent management
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q34. Work-life balance as a 21st-century challenge requires managers to:
options: Prioritize employee well-being and create a supportive work environment
Eliminate remote working options
Focus on shareholder profits over employee satisfaction
Increase work hours to improve productivity
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q35. Globalization affects businesses primarily by:
options: Simplifying regulatory compliance
Reducing the need to understand different cultural environments
Limiting access to international markets
Increasing competition from both domestic and international players
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q36. Which of the following best describes the impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on businesses?
options: AI has eliminated all operational challenges for businesses
AI is one of the emerging technologies managers must adapt to and leverage effectively
AI is only relevant to large multinational corporations
AI has reduced the need for data analytics
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q37. A business that struggles to find employees with the right qualifications for new technology roles is facing which challenge?
options: Talent management and skills gap
Work-life balance
Digital transformation
Data privacy and security
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q38. Which of the following is NOT listed as a 21st-century challenge facing businesses in the chapter?
options: Globalization and international competition
Changing workforce dynamics
Reduction in customer demand
Ethical and social responsibility
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q39. To successfully navigate 21st-century challenges, managers need to:
options: Continuously update their skills and adopt agile leadership approaches
Eliminate diversity in the workplace
Focus solely on maximizing short-term profits
Resist change and maintain traditional practices
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q40. Which of the following management areas would be MOST directly responsible for addressing the "Skills Gap" challenge in a business?
options: Information Technology Management EM MCQ BANK
Human Resource Management
Financial Management
Operations Management
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q1. Operations Management is best defined as:
options: The process of handling legal and regulatory compliance matters
The management of financial transactions and investments within an organization
The coordination of marketing campaigns and promotional activities
The management of the part of an organization responsible for producing goods and/or services
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q2. An Operating System is defined as:
options: A software program that controls computer hardware and networks
A configuration of resources combined for the provision of goods or services
A set of rules and procedures governing employee behavior
A physical infrastructure of a manufacturing plant
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q3. Which of the following is the PRIMARY concern of Operations Management that distinguishes it from other functions like marketing and finance?
options: Maximizing customer satisfaction through after-sales service
Managing human resources and employee relations
Conversion of inputs into outputs using physical resources
Strategic planning and long-term decision making
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q4. Which of the following are examples of inputs used in the transformation process?
options: Capital, labour, and information
Planning, organizing, leading, and controlling
Products, services, profits, and customer satisfaction
Feedback, control, outputs, and quality
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q5. In an operating system, "feedback" refers to:
options: Measurements taken at various points in the transformation process and compared with standards
Employee performance reviews conducted annually
Financial reports submitted to management at year end
Customer complaints submitted after purchasing a product
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q6. Which of the following best describes a "product package"?
options: A marketing strategy used to attract new customers
A combination of goods and services sold together by a company
A bundle of physical goods sold at a discounted price
A financial plan for product development and launch
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q7. Which of the following is an example of an Operating System?
options: A SWOT analysis framework
A hospital providing medical services EM MCQ BANK Chapter 2: Operations Management & Its Importance Page 11 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
A financial budgeting model
A corporate marketing strategy
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q8. The goods-service combination in operations is described as:
options: An equal balance of goods and services in all businesses
A continuum ranging from primarily goods to primarily service
A model only applicable to manufacturing companies
A fixed ratio of goods to services in every product
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q9. Which of the following is listed as an activity under the Scope of Operations Management?
options: Advertising and brand management
Plant layouts and material handling
Recruitment and employee compensation
Financial auditing and reporting
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q10. "Control" in an operating system means:
options: Comparing measurements from the transformation process with established standards to determine if corrective action is needed
Directing employees to follow company policies
Overseeing supplier relationships and procurement activities
Managing the financial budget of the operations department
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q11. Which of the following is NOT listed as an activity under Production and Operations Management functions?
options: Materials Management
Quality Control
Location of Facilities
Sales and Marketing
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q12. Process Design in operations management aims to:
options: Create marketing strategies for new product launches
Develop financial forecasting and budgeting models
Design employee appraisal and performance management systems
Maximize efficiency, minimize waste, and ensure quality in production processes
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q13. Materials Management is concerned with:
options: Managing procurement, storage, and distribution of raw materials and finished goods
Designing new products based on customer preferences
Monitoring employee productivity and performance
Developing marketing plans for new product lines
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q14. Maintenance Management in operations involves:
options: Overseeing financial transactions and investment decisions
Implementing strategies to ensure reliability and longevity of production equipment
Managing employee welfare and benefits programs
Conducting market research for new product development
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q15. Product Design in operations management considers which of the following factors?
options: Employee motivation and job satisfaction
Supplier negotiations and contract management EM MCQ BANK
Manufacturability, cost-effectiveness, and quality
Advertising budgets and promotional strategies
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q16. Which of the following is the FIRST distinction between Production Management and Operations Management?
options: Production management is a newer concept, while operations management is historical
Production management is used for systems producing tangible goods, while operations management covers intangible services
Production management focuses on services, while operations management focuses on goods
Production management deals with HR, while operations management deals with finance
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q17. Which of the following organizations would be covered under Operations Management but NOT traditionally under Production Management?
options: A car manufacturing plant
A textile mill producing fabrics
A bank providing financial services
A steel production factory
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q18. Which term is used in modern times — Production Management or Operations Management?
options: Both are used equally in all industries
Operations Management, as it evolved from Production Management
Production Management, as it is more comprehensive
Neither — the term "Supply Chain Management" has replaced both
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q19. According to Mintzberg, an organization is made up of how many parts?
options: Five
Three
Four
Six
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q20. Which part of Mintzberg's model refers to those who formulate and implement strategy to serve the owners of the organization?
options: Strategic apex
Operating core
Technostructure
Support staff
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q21. In Mintzberg's model, the "Middle Line" refers to:
options: Departments that coordinate work by standardizing processes
Employees who directly produce the goods and services
Staff that provide assistance outside the operational workflow
The hierarchy of authority from strategic apex to front-line supervisors
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q22. The "Technostructure" in Mintzberg's model is concerned with:
options: Formulating the long-term strategy of the organization
Directly producing and delivering products or services to customers
Providing legal advice and catering services to staff
Coordinating work by standardizing processes, outputs, and skills
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q23. Which of the following roles would belong to the "Support Staff" in Mintzberg's model?
options: A middle manager supervising a production team
A senior executive setting company strategy EM MCQ BANK Chapter 2: Operations Management & Its Importance Page 13 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
A legal advisor providing counsel to the organization
A production line worker assembling products
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q24. Human Resource managers and accountants are classified under which part of Mintzberg's model?
options: Technostructure
Strategic apex
Support staff
Operating core
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q25. The "Operating Core" in Mintzberg's model refers to:
options: Staff who standardize processes and outputs across the organization
Individuals who perform the task of rendering the product or service
Senior management responsible for setting organizational strategy
Departments that provide legal and administrative support
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q26. Operations Management is strategically important because it directly impacts:
options: Only the human resource policies of the organization
Competitiveness, profitability, customer satisfaction, and long-term sustainability
Only the financial performance of the organization
Only the marketing and branding strategy of the organization
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q27. Which strategic benefit of Operations Management involves minimizing production costs through efficient resource utilization?
options: Cost Efficiency
Risk Management
Quality Management
Supply Chain Management
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q28. How does Operations Management contribute to Quality Management?
options: By maintaining and improving product or service quality to build reputation and customer satisfaction
By increasing production output at the expense of quality to meet demand
By monitoring financial performance metrics to assess quality standards
By outsourcing quality checks to third-party vendors
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q29. Which strategic importance of Operations Management helps organizations respond quickly to changing market conditions?
options: Cost Efficiency
Flexibility and Adaptability
Supply Chain Management
Risk Management
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q30. Operations Management fosters innovation by:
options: Outsourcing all research and development activities
Reducing investment in new product development to cut costs
Focusing only on existing products and established processes
Integrating customer feedback, market insights, and technological advancements into product design
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q31. Customer Satisfaction in Operations Management is achieved by: EM MCQ BANK Chapter 2: Operations Management & Its Importance Page 14 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
options: Ensuring timely delivery of products or services meeting quality and quantity expectations
Reducing product prices regardless of quality
Increasing advertising spend to attract new customers
Eliminating after-sales service to reduce costs
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q32. Supply Chain Management within Operations Management involves:
options: Managing the entire supply chain from sourcing raw materials to delivering the final product
Focusing only on supplier relationships and ignoring customer delivery
Outsourcing the supply chain to reduce internal costs
Managing only the final delivery of products to customers
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q33. Risk Management in Operations Management involves:
options: Transferring all operational risks to insurance companies
Identifying and mitigating risks associated with production processes and supply chains
Reducing investment in risk assessment to lower overheads
Ignoring potential risks to focus on production targets
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q34. Operations Management promotes sustainability by:
options: Focusing solely on shareholder returns regardless of environmental impact
Maximizing resource consumption to increase output
Outsourcing production to countries with no environmental regulations
Optimizing resource usage, reducing waste, and adopting environmentally friendly practices
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q35. The operations strategy of an organization should be:
options: Developed independently from the corporate strategy
Determined solely by the finance department
Focused only on reducing production costs
Aligned with the overall corporate strategy
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q36. Which competitive factor would drive an organization to focus on "speed of operations" as a performance objective?
options: Customers who want fast delivery of products or services
Customers who want high quality regardless of price
Customers who want low-priced products
Customers who want high customization of products
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q37. When customers require products designed to their own specification, which operational objective becomes most important?
options: Flexibility
Speed
Cost reduction
Quality improvement
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q38. A courier service that ensures packages are delivered on time without loss or damage is focusing on which competitive factor?
options: Speed
Reliability
Flexibility
Cost
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q39. How does Operations Management interact with Accounting and Finance? EM MCQ BANK Chapter 2: Operations Management & Its Importance Page 15 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
options: Operations Management decisions have financial implications, requiring close collaboration with accounting and finance
Operations Management works independently without any financial interaction
Accounting and Finance control all operational decisions without input from operations managers
Operations Management only interacts with finance during annual budget reviews
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q40. In the Hyperstar illustration, keeping inventory levels low contributes to which operations strategy objective?
options: Quality Management
Innovation and Product Development
Flexibility and Adaptability
Cost Leadership through reduced storage and obsolescence costs
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q1. A production system is best defined as:
options: Any method used in industry to create goods and services from various resources
A quality control framework for monitoring output standards
A financial planning tool used to forecast production costs
A method used to manage employees in a manufacturing environment
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q2. The two main categories of production systems are:
options: Manual production and automated production
Large-scale production and small-scale production
Intermittent production system and continuous production system
Job production and batch production
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q3. "Intermittent" in the context of a production system means:
options: Something that follows a fixed and predetermined production schedule
Something that operates constantly without any irregularities
Something that starts and stops at irregular intervals
Something that produces standardized goods in large quantities
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q4. In an intermittent production system, goods are produced:
options: Using fully automated machinery without human involvement
Continuously based on demand forecasts
In large standardized batches for stocking in warehouses
Based on customer orders on a small scale
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q5. Which of the following is a characteristic of an intermittent production system?
options: Products are highly standardized with no variation
Goods are produced on a large scale in anticipation of demand
The flow of production is continuous and uninterrupted
General purpose machines are used that can produce different types of products
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q6. Which of the following is NOT a type of intermittent production system?
options: Jobbing production
Mass production
Batch production
Project production
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q7. The work of a goldsmith making ornaments based on customer orders is an example of:
options: Intermittent production system
Continuous production system
Process production system
Mass production system
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q8. In an intermittent production system, the sequence of operations: EM MCQ BANK Chapter 3: Types of Production Systems Page 17 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
options: Remains fixed and standardized for all products
Is determined only by the production manager
Is fully automated and requires no human input
Changes as per the design of each product
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q9. Which of the following correctly describes the volume of production in an intermittent production system?
options: Small scale based on individual customer orders
Very large scale to meet market-wide demand
Fully automated and continuous
Fixed and predetermined by annual forecasts
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q10. Which of the following is a characteristic shared by ALL types of intermittent production systems?
options: The production flow is continuous and uninterrupted
Products are made and stocked in warehouses until demand arises
Goods are produced on a large scale for standardized markets
Production is based on customer requirements rather than continuous output
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q11. In project production, a company accepts:
options: A single complex order or contract to be completed within a given time and estimated cost
Repeat orders from the same customer on a continuous basis
Multiple small orders from several customers at the same time
Bulk orders based on demand forecasts for warehouse stocking
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q12. Which of the following is an example of project production?
options: Manufacturing toothpaste on a large scale
Producing pharmaceuticals in large batches
Stitching clothes as per individual customer measurements
Construction of airports, dams, and roads
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q13. Which of the following is a characteristic of project production?
options: Production follows a continuous and uninterrupted flow
Routing and scheduling remain fixed throughout the project
Resource requirement is low at the start, increases in the middle, and slows near completion
Resource requirement remains constant throughout the project
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q14. Why do delays commonly occur in project production?
options: Due to lack of customer demand for the product
Due to the complexity and massiveness of the project
Due to the continuous flow of production
Due to the use of general-purpose machines
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q15. In project production, coordination between agencies is important because:
options: The production schedule is fixed and cannot be changed EM MCQ BANK
Each agency works independently without any connection to others
All jobs are interrelated and many agencies perform specialized tasks
All jobs are performed by a single department
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q16. Jobbing production involves:
options: Constructing large infrastructure projects over extended periods
Producing one or few units of a product strictly as per customer specifications
Producing goods in large batches based on demand forecasts
Continuous production of standardized goods for mass markets
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q17. Which of the following is an example of jobbing production?
options: A food company producing thousands of packaged meals daily
A tailor stitching clothes as per individual customer measurements
A pharmaceutical company producing drugs in batches
A cement factory running continuous production
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q18. A key characteristic of jobbing production is:
options: Products are made and stocked until demand arises
The production flow is continuous and uninterrupted
Large volumes of standardized products are produced
Highly skilled labour is required to perform specialized jobs
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q19. In jobbing production, the manufacturing cycle time is described as:
options: Fixed and predetermined at the start of every production run
Perfectly proportionate and balanced between design and production
Disproportionate — for example, the design time may exceed the manufacturing time
Very short because production is fully automated
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q20. The cost in jobbing production is:
options: Variable and determined after completion of the product
Fixed at the time of signing the contract
Determined by the government regulatory authority
Calculated based on average market prices
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q21. Batch production schedules are decided according to:
options: Specific customer orders or demand forecasts
Employee availability and shift timings
Government production regulations and industry standards
The availability of raw materials from suppliers
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q22. In batch production, all jobs of one batch must be:
options: Completed simultaneously with the next batch
Reviewed by quality control before designing the next product
Outsourced to a third-party manufacturer
Completed before starting the next batch of production
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q23. Which of the following is an example of batch production?
options: Steel production in a continuous processing plant
A tailor stitching a custom suit
Construction of a highway overpass
Manufacturing of drugs and pharmaceuticals
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q24. A characteristic of batch production is:
options: The production system is designed for only one specific type of item
There is very little or no work-in-progress
There is a possibility of large work-in-progress EM MCQ BANK Chapter 3: Types of Production Systems Page 19 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
Products are produced based solely on individual customer orders
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q25. General purpose machines are used in batch production because:
options: They eliminate the need for production planning and control
They reduce the need for skilled labour completely
They can only produce one type of product efficiently
Large varieties of items need to be produced quickly
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q26. In a continuous production system, goods are produced:
options: Constantly based on demand forecasts on a large scale
In batches with regular intervals between each production run
Based on individual customer orders on a small scale
Only when raw materials are available from suppliers
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q27. Which of the following is a characteristic of a continuous production system?
options: General-purpose machines are used for a variety of products
The flow of production is intermittent and irregular
Products are standardized and produced on predetermined quality standards
Products are varied and change according to customer orders
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q28. In a continuous production system, inputs and outputs are:
options: Varied to accommodate different customer specifications
Customized based on individual customer requirements
Standardized along with the production process and sequence
Determined by the availability of raw materials
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q29. Which of the following is an example of a continuous production system?
options: A goldsmith making custom jewellery
A construction company building a dam
A tailor stitching individual garments
A food industry producing large-scale food based on demand forecasts
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q30. The two types of continuous production systems are:
options: Project production and jobbing production
Intermittent production and batch production
Batch production and project production
Mass production and process production
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q31. In mass production, goods are produced:
options: As a single type of product with zero flexibility
In small quantities based on specific customer orders
In batches with production halts between each run
In large quantities using either a single operation or a series of operations
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q32. Which of the following is an example of mass production?
options: Production of steel in a continuous processing plant
Manufacturing of toothpastes, soaps, and pens EM MCQ BANK Chapter 3: Types of Production Systems Page 20 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
Construction of an airport
A repair shop providing customized mechanical services
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q33. Which of the following is a characteristic of mass production?
options: Highly skilled labour is required for each production stage
Products are manufactured strictly as per customer specifications
High work-in-progress due to irregular production flow
Material handling is done mostly by machines such as conveyors
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q34. In mass production, supervision is described as:
options: Complex and requiring highly specialized supervisory staff
Easy because only a few instructions are necessary
Unnecessary because production is fully automated
Managed entirely by external quality control agencies
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q35. Process production is characterized by:
options: Producing only one specific type of product with almost zero flexibility
Using general-purpose machines to accommodate product variety
Producing goods strictly based on customer orders
Producing multiple types of products with high flexibility
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q36. Which of the following is an example of process production?
options: Tailoring of custom-fitted garments
Production of steel, cement, or sugar
Construction of large infrastructure projects
Manufacturing of pharmaceuticals in batches
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q37. In process production, the level of work-in-progress is:
options: Moderate and dependent on customer order volumes
Unpredictable and varies with market demand
Very less because material flow is continuous
Very high due to complex and varied production processes
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q38. Which of the following correctly compares mass production and process production?
options: Mass production produces different product types in large volumes; process production produces only one product type
Both rely on customer orders to determine production volumes
Both produce a variety of products with high flexibility
Mass production has zero flexibility; process production produces multiple product types
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q39. In process production, labour requirements are described as:
options: No labour required as the process is fully automated
Low-skilled labour and skilled technicians
Highly skilled workers for every stage of production
Only unskilled workers with no technical knowledge
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q40. Production planning and scheduling in process production:
options: Cannot be determined in advance due to unpredictable demand
Is done randomly based on daily operational requirements
Is outsourced to third-party logistics companies EM MCQ BANK
Can be decided well in advance due to continuous and standardized production
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q1. Production Planning and Control is best compared to which of the following in a production operation?
options: The financial engine that drives profitability
The marketing framework that guides customer interactions
The skeleton that provides structure to the organization
The nervous system of a production operation
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q2. The primary concern of Production Planning and Control is:
options: Developing new product designs based on customer feedback
Maximizing employee productivity and reducing absenteeism
Managing supplier relationships and procurement contracts
Delivery of products to customers or inventory stocks according to a predetermined schedule
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q3. From a long-term perspective (seven to ten years or more), production planning largely deals with:
options: Capital equipment budgeting and plant capacity
Inventory goals and wage budgets
Short-range utilization of labour, materials, and physical facilities
Plant construction, location, product-line design, and development
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q4. Short-range production planning (several months to a year) focuses on:
options: Inventory goals and wage budgets
Plant construction and product-line development
Capital-equipment budgeting and plant capacity
Long-term market expansion and international growth
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q5. Medium-range plans projected over a two-to-five-year period are primarily concerned with:
options: Capital-equipment budgeting and plant capacity and layout
Customer order processing and dispatch management
Daily production schedules and shift timings
Inventory management and short-term material procurement
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q6. The ultimate objective of Production Planning and Control is to:
options: Maximize production output regardless of quality standards
Eliminate all forms of work-in-progress from the production system
Contribute to the profits of the enterprise by keeping customers satisfied through meeting delivery schedules
Minimize the number of employees required in the production process
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q7. Which of the following is a specific objective of Production Planning and Control? EM MCQ BANK Chapter 4: Production Planning & Control and Operations Management Systems Page 23 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
options: Maximizing shareholder returns through aggressive pricing
Recruiting and training skilled employees for the production line
Developing marketing campaigns to increase product demand
Establishing routes and schedules for work to ensure optimum utilization of raw materials, laborers, and machines
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q8. Production Planning and Control is essentially concerned with the control of:
options: Marketing strategies and brand management
Customer complaints and after-sales service
Financial budgets and investment decisions
Work-in-process
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q9. Which of the following is listed as an objective fulfilled by Production Planning and Control?
options: Conducting market research to identify new customer segments
Managing employee salaries and compensation packages
Developing new products based on emerging market trends
Analyzing orders to determine raw materials and parts required for completion
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q10. Which function of Production Planning and Control involves laying down the path for work to follow and the order in which operations will be carried out?
options: Scheduling
Routing
Dispatching
Follow-up
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q11. "Scheduling" as a function of Production Planning and Control means:
options: Establishing the quantity of work to be done and fixing the timetable for performing operations
Checking whether work proceeds according to predetermined plans
Conducting inspection of products to ensure high quality
Issuing necessary orders to ensure time targets are effectively achieved
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q12. "Dispatching" in Production Planning and Control refers to:
options: Laying down the path and sequence of operations
Checking work against predetermined plans and identifying variances
Issuing necessary orders and taking steps to ensure time targets are achieved
Fixing the timetable and quantity of work to be done
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q13. The "Follow-up" function in Production Planning and Control involves:
options: Issuing requisitions for the purchase of necessary materials
Notifying sales and accounting of order acceptance
Taking steps to check whether work proceeds according to predetermined plans and identifying variances
Preparing route sheets showing the sequence of operations
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q14. Which of the following is listed as a function of Production Planning and Control?
options: Inspection — conducting check-ups of products to ensure high quality
Developing IT infrastructure for data management EM MCQ BANK
Managing customer relationship profiles and communication records
Conducting SWOT analysis for strategic planning
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q15. Production Planning and Control assists which department in making cost estimates of orders?
options: Marketing department
Human resource department
Costing department
IT department
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q16. MRP stands for:
options: Material Requirements Planning
Management Resource Planning
Manufacturing Resource Production
Manufacturing Routing Process
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q17. MRP is best described as:
options: A computerized system for planning the requirements for raw materials, work-in-progress, and finished items
A financial budgeting tool for managing production costs
A manual system for tracking employee performance in manufacturing
A marketing system for forecasting customer demand
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q18. Which of the following is a critical piece of information provided by an MRP system?
options: Employee performance ratings and salary benchmarks
Marketing strategies for new product launches
Financial investment plans for capital equipment
The number of products to be manufactured based on customer demand
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q19. A "Bill of Materials" in the context of MRP refers to:
options: A schedule showing when products will be delivered to customers
A document listing every part and component required to build a product
A report comparing actual production output with planned targets
A financial statement listing the total cost of production
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q20. Which of the following is a benefit of MRP?
options: The MRP schedule can be amended quickly if demand estimates change since the system is computerized
Increases stock holding to ensure supply availability at all times
Eliminates the need for production planning entirely
Removes the need for collaboration with suppliers
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q21. MRP would NOT be suitable in which of the following situations?
options: When production involves a series of automated processes
When a company produces large volumes of standardized goods
When it is not possible to predict sales in advance
When a company has a well-established supplier network
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q22. MRP II is best described as:
options: A replacement for ERP that focuses solely on inventory management

An upgraded version of MRP that takes into account additional requirements beyond inventory EM MCQ BANK Chapter 4: Production Planning & Control and Operations Management Systems Page 25 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
A system that only manages workforce availability in manufacturing
A basic computerized system for tracking raw material stock levels
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q23. Which of the following is an additional requirement considered by MRP II that is NOT covered by basic MRP?
options: Bill of materials and on-hand inventory
Customer demand forecasting and order management
Financial budgeting and investment planning
Manufacturing workforce availability and production capacity of the production line
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q24. MRP II provides which key feature that improves organizational coordination?
options: A central database that all functions have access to, ensuring everyone works from the same information
A decentralized database allowing each department to manage its own data
A financial database for managing investment portfolios
A marketing database for tracking customer purchase history
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q25. In comparing MRP and MRP II, which statement is CORRECT regarding "Resources"?
options: Both MRP and MRP II list identical resources with no distinction
Neither MRP nor MRP II tracks workforce or equipment resources
MRP lists only materials requirements; MRP II lists all needed resources including equipment and workforce
MRP lists all needed resources including equipment and workforce; MRP II lists only materials
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q26. Regarding "Scope," how does MRP II differ from MRP?
options: MRP focuses on the entire organization; MRP II focuses only on manufacturing
MRP focuses solely on the manufacturing area; MRP II looks at the company as a whole
MRP II focuses only on financial operations; MRP focuses on production
Both MRP and MRP II focus exclusively on the manufacturing department
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q27. ERP stands for:
options: Enterprise Resource Planning
Extended Resource Programming
Efficient Resource Planning
Enterprise Routing Process
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q28. ERP is best described as:
options: A marketing system for managing customer relationships
A basic inventory management system focused on raw materials
An extension of MRP II that integrates data from all operations within the organization
A financial planning tool for managing capital investments
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q29. Which of the following companies is mentioned in the text as specializing in ERP systems?
options: SAP and Oracle
IBM and Dell
Microsoft and Apple
Amazon and Google
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q30. Which of the following is a feature of ERP systems?
options: Restricting system access to senior management only
Focusing solely on inventory and production management EM MCQ BANK Chapter 4: Production Planning & Control and Operations Management Systems Page 26 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
Eliminating the need for supplier and customer communication
Decision support features to assist management with decision-making
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q31. A disadvantage of ERP systems is:
options: The cost may be prohibitive for some organizations
It limits the ability to forecast demand accurately
It increases inventory holding costs significantly
It reduces data sharing between departments
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q32. OPT stands for:
options: Organizing Planning Technology
Optimized Planning Techniques
Output Production Technology
Optimized Production Technology
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q33. OPT is essentially based on:
options: Maximizing production output by increasing machine speed
Reducing workforce requirements through full automation
The identification and removal of bottlenecks in the production line
Standardizing all production processes to eliminate variation
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q34. The aim of the OPT method is to:
options: Put a maximum just-in-time flow through the whole chain without creating additional stocks
Outsource bottleneck operations to third-party manufacturers
Create additional intermediate stocks to buffer against production delays
Increase production capacity by adding more machines to the production line
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q35. In OPT, low-capacity resources in the production line are described as:
options: Tools that help eliminate unnecessary steps in the production process
Assets that increase production efficiency and output
Resources that can be safely ignored in production planning
Obstacles to daily output that generate growing stocks if not identified
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q36. In the production transformation process, which of the following are identified as key resources?
options: Materials, labor, and overhead
Strategy, finance, operations, and HR
Marketing, sales, branding, and advertising
Planning, organizing, leading, and controlling
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q37. An operations manager is best described as:
options: A senior executive responsible for setting the corporate strategy
The upper-level manager who directs the transformation process of resources into goods or services
A marketing specialist responsible for product launches and promotions
A financial analyst responsible for managing production budgets
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q38. Which of the following is a responsibility of the operations manager related to "Production Control"? EM MCQ BANK Chapter 4: Production Planning & Control and Operations Management Systems Page 27 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
options: Determining which production process is best for manufacturing goods
Deciding where the production facility will be located
Ensuring goods are produced according to quality specifications
Scheduling and monitoring activities, responding to feedback, and overseeing purchasing and inventories
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q39. The "Make-to-Order" strategy is best suited for:
options: Mass customization of products combining standardized and custom features
High-volume production of standardized goods stored in inventory for later sale
Continuous production of a single product type for mass markets
Low-volume, high-variety goods produced according to customer specifications
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q40. Which of the following is an example of a company using mass customization?
options: A steel plant continuously producing a single type of steel product
Nike allowing customers to configure their own athletic shoes through the Nike ID program
A food company producing thousands of standardized packaged meals
A pharmaceutical company manufacturing drugs in large batches
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q41. A disadvantage of mass production is:
options: Production planning and scheduling cannot be done in advance
Customers cannot have products customized to their individual needs
High production costs due to low volume output
It requires highly skilled labour for every stage of production
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q42. Mass customization combines the advantages of:
options: Continuous production and intermittent production
Project production and batch production
Job production and process production
Customized products and mass production
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q43. Which factor should operations managers consider when selecting a production site?
options: Maximizing distance from suppliers to reduce dependency
Selecting locations with the highest population density only
Choosing locations where land, labor, construction, utilities, and taxes are low
Prioritizing locations far from customers to protect trade secrets
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q44. Capacity planning involves:
options: Recruiting and training employees to meet production targets
Determining the maximum number of goods that can be produced over a given time under normal working conditions
Deciding which marketing strategy to use for a new product launch
Managing supplier contracts to ensure raw material availability
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q45. Which of the following best describes the consequence of setting production capacity TOO HIGH?
options: The company will be unable to meet customer demand and will lose sales
The company will be forced to reduce its product variety EM MCQ BANK
The company will face a shortage of raw materials from suppliers
The company will waste resources and inflate operating costs
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q1. Maintenance is best defined as:
options: The process of outsourcing production activities to reduce operational costs
The process of replacing all old machines with new ones after a fixed period
The process of hiring specialized engineers to redesign production equipment
The process of keeping machines and equipment in good working condition to retain efficiency and increase life
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q2. Plant maintenance is defined as:
options: A financial plan for replacing old equipment with new technology
A marketing strategy for promoting plant efficiency to investors
A system for training employees on how to operate production machinery
A combination of actions to replace, repair, and service machineries and components in a manufacturing plant so it continues to operate satisfactorily
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q3. The general aim of plant maintenance is to:
options: Reduce the number of machines in use to lower operational costs
Eliminate all human involvement from the production process
Create a productive working environment that is also safe for workers
Maximize the speed of production at the expense of equipment longevity
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q4. Which of the following is a stated objective of plant maintenance?
options: To maximize production output regardless of equipment condition
To eliminate the need for a dedicated maintenance department
To achieve minimum breakdown and keep the plant in good working condition at the lowest possible cost
To replace all machinery on a fixed annual schedule
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q5. Plant maintenance ensures that machines and facilities are kept in a condition that allows them to be used at:
options: Their optimum profit-making capacity without any interruption or hindrance
Variable capacity based on daily production targets
Maximum speed regardless of efficiency
Minimum capacity to reduce wear and tear
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q6. Maintenance is defined as finding faults in equipment and their removal. This process may occur:
options: Either before or after a breakdown
Only during scheduled annual overhauls EM MCQ BANK
Only before a breakdown occurs
Only after a breakdown occurs
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q7. Which of the following is listed as an importance of plant maintenance?
options: Equipment breakdown leads to an inevitable loss of production
It reduces the need for quality control in the production process
It eliminates the need for skilled labour on the production floor
It eliminates the need for production planning and control
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q8. If a piece of equipment goes out of order in a flow production factory:
options: Only that machine stops while other production lines continue normally
Backup machines automatically replace the faulty equipment
The entire production line will soon come to a halt
Production continues at a reduced speed without interruption
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q9. Which of the following is NOT listed as a problem created by plant breakdown?
options: Spoilt materials due to sudden stoppage
Increased product quality and customer satisfaction
Need for overtime and subcontracting work
Loss in production time
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q10. An un-properly maintained or neglected plant will:
options: Eventually require expensive and frequent repairs as machines wear out
Operate more efficiently due to reduced interference
Improve product quality by adapting to production demands
Automatically self-correct through regular use
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q11. The three main categories of plant maintenance are:
options: Daily maintenance, weekly maintenance, and annual maintenance
Predictive maintenance, automated maintenance, and manual maintenance
Routine maintenance, emergency maintenance, and scheduled maintenance
Corrective/breakdown maintenance, scheduled maintenance, and preventive maintenance
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q12. Corrective or breakdown maintenance implies that:
options: Repairs are made after the equipment is out of order and cannot perform its normal function
Repairs are scheduled in advance to prevent equipment failure
Maintenance engineers continuously monitor equipment to prevent failure
Equipment is replaced entirely when it shows signs of wear
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q13. After removing the fault in corrective/breakdown maintenance, maintenance engineers:
options: Submit a detailed report to the operations manager for review
Replace the equipment with a newer model
Schedule the next preventive maintenance visit immediately
Do not attend the equipment again until another failure or breakdown occurs
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q14. Breakdown maintenance may be justified in small factories that:
options: Operate in industries with strict regulatory requirements

Are indifferent to the benefits of scheduling and do not feel financial justification for scheduling techniques EM MCQ BANK Chapter 5: Plant Maintenance & Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) Page 31 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
Have high production volumes and tight delivery schedules
Use highly automated production systems with minimal human involvement
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q15. Which of the following is a typical cause of equipment breakdown?
options: Failure to replace worn-out parts and lack of lubrication
Using high-quality spare parts recommended by manufacturers
Conducting frequent preventive maintenance inspections
Regular lubrication and timely replacement of worn parts
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q16. Which of the following is a disadvantage of breakdown maintenance?
options: It requires significant administrative work and detailed records
It requires large teams of specialized maintenance engineers
It leads to excessive delays in production and poor hurried maintenance
It prevents any production interruptions or schedule changes
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q17. Breakdown maintenance CANNOT be used for plant items that are:
options: Old and frequently breaking down
Regulated by statutory provisions such as cranes, lifts, hoists, and pressure vessels
Located in remote sections of the factory
Critical to the main production line
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q18. Scheduled maintenance is described as:
options: A stitch-in-time procedure aimed at avoiding breakdowns by incorporating inspection, lubrication, repair, and overhaul
A maintenance approach that relies entirely on employee observation
Repairs carried out only after equipment completely fails
An emergency maintenance approach used during production crises
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q19. Scheduled maintenance practice is generally followed for:
options: Training new maintenance employees on equipment operation
Overhauling of machines, cleaning of water and other tanks, and white-washing of buildings
Emergency repairs during production breakdowns
Replacing all machines on a fixed annual schedule
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q20. The underlying principle of Preventive Maintenance is:
options: Fix it when it breaks
Prevention is better than cure
Replace equipment before it shows any signs of wear
Schedule repairs only when production targets are missed
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q21. Preventive Maintenance (PM) involves:
options: Outsourcing all maintenance activities to external specialists
Making emergency repairs after equipment completely fails
Replacing all equipment on a fixed schedule regardless of condition
Periodic inspection of equipment to uncover conditions that lead to breakdown, and upkeep to correct such conditions while still minor
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q22. Preventive maintenance is practiced to some extent in approximately what percentage of manufacturing companies? EM MCQ BANK Chapter 5: Plant Maintenance & Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) Page 32 Complete MCQ Reference All Chapters Included
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q23. The key to all good preventive maintenance programs is:
options: Replacing all spare parts at regular fixed intervals
Having the largest possible maintenance team
Inspection
Using the most advanced computer systems
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q24. Which of the following is an objective of Preventive Maintenance?
options: To minimize the possibility of unanticipated production interruption by locating conditions that may lead to it
To maximize the use of equipment beyond its designed capacity
To reduce the number of production employees required
To eliminate the need for any maintenance department
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q25. A preventive maintenance programme must be:
options: Purchased as a ready-made package from equipment manufacturers
Designed exclusively by external maintenance consultants
Identical for all industries regardless of size or location
Tailor-made to fit the requirements of the individual industry or plant
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q26. When determining the frequency of PM inspections, which factor must always take precedence over financial considerations?
options: Safety standards
Budget availability and cost of maintenance
Equipment age and manufacturer recommendations
Production targets and delivery deadlines
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q27. Over-inspection in preventive maintenance:
options: Is needlessly expensive and may involve more productive downtime than an emergency breakdown
Is always beneficial regardless of cost
Eliminates all possibility of equipment breakdown
Reduces the need for spare parts storage
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q28. Spare parts are stored primarily in order to:
options: Reduce the loss of production time during equipment breakdowns
Reduce the need for a dedicated maintenance department
Increase the total number of machines in the factory
Comply with government regulations on equipment management
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q29. Predictive maintenance uses which of the following to predict equipment troubles before failure?
options: Daily financial reports on equipment performance and cost EM MCQ BANK
Outsourcing maintenance to specialists who monitor equipment remotely
Human senses or sensitive instruments such as audio gauges, vibration analyzers, and pressure gauges
Regular replacement of all machine parts on a fixed schedule
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q30. Which of the following maintenance techniques was shown to reduce shutdown time from 18 to 16 days in a refinery, adding 90,000 barrels to production volume?
options: Use of operations research
Use of work study
PERT (Programme Evaluation and Review Technique)
Use of computers
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option B

questions.question: Q31. CPM (Critical Path Method) has enabled some firms to cut their downtime by:
options: has enabled some firms to cut their downtime by: A) 5 to 10% B) 10 to 15% C) 20 to 30% D) 40 to 50%
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q32. Which scheduling tool contains more written details and can be used for historical records?
options: Individual cards
Scheduling boards
Visual charts
Computer-generated reports
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q33. A Master Maintenance Schedule indicates:
options: The nature and magnitude of each repair and construction task segment for a specified time span
The financial budget allocated for maintenance activities
The daily tasks assigned to each maintenance worker
The list of spare parts required for the upcoming month
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option A

questions.question: Q34. The Detailed Weekly Work Schedule provides information to each craft and shop regarding:
options: The annual budget for maintenance activities
The performance evaluation of each maintenance employee
The task to be carried on each job for each day in the coming week
The complete list of spare parts required for the year
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option C

questions.question: Q35. Which of the following is listed as an advantage of Preventive Maintenance?
options: Higher maintenance and repair costs due to frequent inspections
Increased need for large-scale and repetitive repairs
Increased breakdown frequency and associated downtime
Reduced breakdowns, lesser odd-time repairs, and greater safety for workers
questions.explanation: Correct option according to Answer Key is Option D

questions.question: Q36. Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) is best defined as:
options: The process of using machines, equipment, employees, and supporting processes to maintain and improve the integrity of production and quality of systems
A marketing approach to improving the image of the production facility
A system where only specialized engineers are responsible for maintaining all equipment
